call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished flat Korean online beach-cleanup recruitment poster, horizontal landscape aspect ratio exactly 3:2. Edge-to-edge poster artwork, opaque background, no mockup or photographed printed object. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력. Use the maximum native resolution supported by this tool/model, preserve 3:2. No references are supplied: create a fresh design.

The core visual idea is COLLECTING TOGETHER INTO ONE COMMON OPEN BAG. Design a precise graphic print poster whose broad open collection-bag silhouette and the visible bottle-to-bag joining action organize one shared landscape reading space. Use flat crisp ink shapes, bold economical contours, no faces or full people, no beach scenery. A single cropped gloved hand holding a litter picker, its continuous shaft and jaws gripping one bottle at the mouth of one open collection bag are the sole image. Do not add other litter, props, faces, heads, mountains, ocean, sun, symbols or icons.

Composition and reading: use a wide common entry axis across the landscape, with an intentional Korean title rhythm and the application immediately below in the same broad shared reading area. Avoid the generic composition of a giant left masthead opposite a right-hand scene/catalog. Let one broad shallow open bag mouth extend across most of the page and lead the title into the prominent application deadline and uninterrupted full URL. The title is clearly found across this shared entry space, and the recruitment name is close enough and substantial enough to immediately tell viewers this is a recruitment poster. The bag front is a large continuous quiet reading plane whose outer contour is visibly the same collection bag as the opening, rather than separate floating text cards. Organize all remaining complete sentences into a short coherent reading path across that plane, with adjacent semantic groups and clear paragraph spacing: event date/time/place together; participation eligibility/free/no-certificate conditions together; supplied tools/personal preparation/rain notice together; inquiry near participation. Use meaningful line breaks, optical alignment and useful margins instead of scattered captions or individually floating labels. Do not pack the conditions into a tiny footer band. Do not force the information into matching isolated columns. A shallow stagger of paragraph margins can follow the bag's broad contour while retaining an obvious reading order. The whole poster must function at a 720-pixel-wide view: generous substantial body type, readable full sentences, no tiny copy. Reduce the pictorial detail to preserve room for all twelve texts. The event date is subordinate to title/application, not another giant competing masthead. Distinguish 11월 18일까지 as the application deadline from 2026년 11월 21일 as the event date.

The functional graphic must be unmistakable. Crop only a forearm and correctly shaped gloved hand naturally entering from the page edge beside the shared entry space. The glove physically grips ONE ordinary pistol-style litter-picker handle with a short trigger. ONE uninterrupted straight shaft leads to ONE pair of short opposed jaws. Those jaws visibly contact and grip the body of ONE small discarded bottle directly at the wide open bag mouth. Draw the bottle, jaws and bag rim as clean separate silhouettes: not a bottle floating apart from the jaws, not separate rods, not a grabber with an impossible joint, not a closed sack. The near and far rim of the mouth form a clear shallow opening and the bag front continues from it. The graphic route and mouth create the relationship between the title, joining/application and useful body information, not a decorative illustration parked next to the type. Protect the glyphs and full URL from the tool, bottle, folds and contour. Use only a few deliberate bag folds needed to identify it. No invented physical dimensions or product branding.

Style: controlled three-ink-style graphic language, sharply drawn matte shapes and confident dark ink. Warm yellow outer field, a clear ivory bag reading surface, dark almost-black typography/contours, and a restrained deep green for the functional bottle or a useful application emphasis. No cheerful blue volunteer cartoon, photorealism, anime, global paper texture, artificial distress, grain, glow, glossy 3D, ornamental cut-outs or fake print registration. Typography has dense confident Korean headline forms and clean robust Korean sans-serif body forms, deliberate word spacing, calm line spacing and high contrast. Any surface color is flat; precision comes from contour, contact and typographic rhythm rather than arbitrary texture. No added labels, group headings, numbered steps, decorative letters, dividers, arrows, icons, logos, QR code or watermark.

Only these twelve exact text values may appear, each exactly ONCE. Preserve every word, Korean glyph, space, number, punctuation mark, Latin lowercase letter and full URL. Natural line breaks between words are allowed, but never change or abbreviate the copy and never break within haram-wave.example/join. Do not duplicate any title as a small caption or add production text:
우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일
하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집
2026년 11월 21일 토요일
오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료
하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8
대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명
집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.
개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.
우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.
참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.
11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join
문의: 바다정화 운영팀

Keep every exact condition clearly readable on the finished 720-wide flat poster. Application deadline/full address and title must be immediately identifiable. Keep safe margins around all copy. Deliver one coherent independently composed 3:2 poster, no alternate versions or multiple panels.

residual_defects.evidence: 상단 두 줄의 제목/모집명과 하단의 신청 문장 사이에 봉투 입구와 일정/조건 묶음이 놓였다. 신청은 큰 굵은 글자와 초록 URL로 즉시 식별되지만 제목과 인접하지 않는다.
residual_defects.impact: 공유 진입축에서 바로 신청하는 의도는 부분적으로만 구현됐다. 제목에서 신청까지 아래로 크게 이동해야 한다.

residual_defects.evidence: 좌측 행사 날짜가 우측 조건 글자보다 약 두 배 크며 시간/장소도 우측 조건보다 크다. 일정과 우측 안내가 두 개의 직사각형 문구 묶음으로 배열됐다.
residual_defects.impact: 봉투라는 한 표면은 공유하지만 편집은 좌측 일정/우측 안내로 분리돼 있고 큰 날짜가 신청보다 먼저 주목받을 수 있다.

residual_defects.evidence: 대상은 우측 안내의 첫 줄, 비용/확인서는 제공/개인준비/우천 다음 마지막 줄, 문의는 신청 문장의 멀리 오른쪽에 있다.
residual_defects.impact: 참여 판단 조건이 서로 직접 인접하지 않고 신청/문의까지 하나의 연속 읽는 경로로 완전히 묶이지 않았다.

residual_defects.evidence: 집게의 사선 축이 모집명의 오른쪽 아래 가까이 지나간다. 실제 글자 획을 가리는 중첩은 보지 못했지만720에서 여유 간격은 좁다.
residual_defects.impact: 전체 경계는 읽히지만 마지막 어절 옆의 광학 여백이 조금 빡빡하다.

residual_defects.evidence: 노란 배경에는 약한 색 변화가 있고 봉투 면은 음영으로, 병은 흰 반사형 띠로 묘사됐다. 집게의 검은 턱이 병의 오른쪽 몸통을 감싸지만 원본에서도 안쪽 턱 일부는 병과 겹친다.
residual_defects.impact: 선명한 그래픽과 행동은 읽히나 완전히 균일한 무광 색면이라는 제작 명세와 차이가 있고 정밀 기구 접촉의 모든 경계를 따로 확인할 수는 없다.
